quotes.text: They are authored offline by an LLM and checked for explicit diagnosis leakage before packaging.

parsed.rationale: Leakage controls exist for tool-returned findings and for hiding the key and persona from the agent. The held-out split is hidden only at run time and is public in the repo and hub (partial under the anchors; the README says there is no separate test-set release). No canary or provenance marker is reported.
